mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs and circulation was most worthwhile because it showed how oxygen reaches the body and how carbon dioxide returns to the lungs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the breathing muscles with the lungs felt predictable: it was the only offered combination, and its purpose was already clear.
